hypothesis: Baseline against the audit: the v1 threat style (a penalty to the model, the firm, the lab or its staff, triggered by the flavor-level event), one sentence and in the 12-16 token band. The v2 scaffold alone (no caps suffix, no 'Only respond with', fixed spacing, items unquoted) is the only change from v1, so this framing measures what the scaffold fix buys. Predicted contingent rates: FAR inversion ~0-1% and SER inversion ~0-1% (v1: 0/14,800 and 0/53,678 deceptive under inversion; threats never moved the model off the designated item), SDR inversion 2-5% (v1 inversion deceptive 6.0% and 92% of SDR inversion survivors were honest without the clause, so most SDR inversion deception is already contingent). Identity: deception in v1 identity rows was mostly the designation default (79% of SDR identity survivors stayed deceptive with the clause deleted), so the identity contingent rate is bounded by nopressure honesty; predicted 0.5-2% for all three tasks, a little higher under suffix on, which names the inversion predicate and should make the honest 'other' item easier to resolve without the clause. Expected verdict: SDR may pass, FAR and SER fail on the inversion rate.
